title: When the Passage Turns
author: Rosalind Nystrom
blurb: Noor Reyes, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
